title: NumericalPDE PorousMediumTravelingWave

stats.done_summary: Task completed successfully. Implemented adaptive-step numerical integration of the porous media equation traveling wave ODE using SciPy's DOP853 method (rtol=1e-8, atol=1e-10). Generated 6 figures showing: (1) traveling wave profiles for m∈{0.5,1.0,1.5,2.0,3.0}, (2) numerical vs analytical validation (max error 2.41e-7), (3) error convergence analysis (front position error reaches 4.24e-14 at tol=1e-12), (4) adaptive step size evolution, (5) front position vs exponent, and (6) normalized profiles. Front positions captured with errors below 1e-10 for m≥1.5. All deliverables complete: code/porous_media_tw.py, outputs/numerical_results.npz, report/report.md, and 6 PNG figures in report/images/.
